small.name: Small fruit platter on its round tray
small.traits: pineapple crown at the top, red grapes on the left, the tall watermelon wedge in the middle, dates and walnuts, pomegranate, the round tray under yellow melon slices; every fruit in its place, nothing added.
small.source: her own photo (scrollcraft/builds/ls-fruit-platter/gen/platters-brief.md:6,13). Never use src/owner/h-*.jpg: those are generated.

medium.name: Medium fruit platter on a wooden board with a handle
medium.traits: dark grapes on the left, pineapple chunks and crown, lychees, watermelon slices fanned on the right, sliced green melon at the front, a wooden board with a handle. The books, vase and bowl in her photo are props, not the platter.

large.name: Large fruit platter on a long board
large.traits: green grapes, dates, pineapple, kiwi, lychees, red grapes, pomegranate and a long fan of melon slices on a long wooden board; every fruit in its place.

xl.name: XL fruit platter on a narrow long board
xl.traits: green grapes, kiwi and melon, dates and pomegranate, dark grapes and a watermelon strip in rows along the narrow long board.
xl.source: her own photo (platters-brief.md:6,13); the model redraws the cut of some pieces, so the exact slice count is not guaranteed (platters-brief.md:15)
